latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI by Prompt — fast, AI-powered video edits using simple text instructions.

- Upload raw footage and describe edits with text prompts (e.g., "cut the pauses, add BGM, add title")
- Automatic setup: handles authentication and session management for you
- Supports multiple common video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB)
- Exports finished videos as 1080p MP4, ready to post
- Tracks your editing session and available credits; free trials with 100 credits for new users
- Designed for content creators and marketers seeking rapid edits without learning traditional video editors
